description: By Christopher Walsh Chris Gallant, an Army National Guard pilot, former air traffic controller, union leader, and volunteer firefighter, is the apparent winner of Tuesday's Democratic primary for New York's First Congressional District. Should the Suffolk County Board of Elections' unofficial count stand, Mr. Gallant, a newcomer to politics, will…
